Iran threatens Gulf states over potential US strikes

Iran has threatened to strike Gulf states if the United States launches new attacks. Tehran's warning indicated that any further US strike would result in retaliatory attacks across the Gulf region. The coverage highlights Iran's threat to target energy hubs in the Gulf. This statement was made in the context of potential new US strikes.
